input: original private revision1216, 1213 BGE-M3 dense1024 vectors, 16 authored triples

measurements.prewarm: one ordinary request per backend, separately charged and reported
measurements.ordinary_exact_cache_control: each query miss immediately followed by identical hit; controlled pairs, no natural hit-rate claim
measurements.anchor_matching: 16 existing anchor vectors, current query IP top1, self-vector hash excluded; raw matching overhead measured separately

semantic_review.pool: top two full-canonical results of each anchor; same two evidence candidates reviewed against all three wordings
semantic_review.reviewer: assistant evidence review, provisional; not user-accepted gold

opportunity: component removal ceilings and p*t > lookup + amortized fill + invalidation maintenance; no assumed p from authored triples
limitations: materialized snapshot source checks are not original-file I/O
no physical disk traffic or hard CPU caps
stop: deliver evidence review, workload card and opportunity ceilings; choose no new mechanism until natural workload evidence supports it
